:::{#exm-cohen-kappa-covid}
#### Cohen's kappa for the COVID-19 test

For the agreement table of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
$p_o = 0.99$ (@exm-overall-agreement)
and $p_e = 0.862404$ (@exm-chance-agreement),
so Cohen's kappa (@def-cohen-kappa) is:

$$
\ba
\kappa
&= \frac{0.99 - 0.862404}{1 - 0.862404}
&& \text{(definition of } \kappa \text{)} \\
&= \frac{0.127596}{1 - 0.862404}
&& \text{(subtract in the numerator)} \\
&= \frac{0.127596}{0.137596}
&& \text{(subtract in the denominator)} \\
&\approx 0.927
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$

```{r}
kappa_from_table <- function(a, b, c, d) {
  n <- a + b + c + d
  p_o <- (a + d) / n
  p_e <- ((a + b) * (a + c) + (c + d) * (b + d)) / n^2
  (p_o - p_e) / (1 - p_e)
}
do.call(kappa_from_table, as.list(agree_covid))
```

:::
